name: locations_by_id
note: StockLocation (addons/stock/models/stock_location.py): every location with its usage, parent, warehouse and active flag as the ORM reads them (active_test off); complete_name is the stored _rec_name
source_sql: SELECT id, usage, location_id, warehouse_id, company_id, active, complete_name FROM stock_location ORDER BY id

name: rules_per_route
note: stock.route.rule_ids one2many (addons/stock/models/stock_location.py) embedded as stockRoute.stockRule: rules per route with the active and pull-action counts; routes without rules excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT route_id, count(*) AS rules, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_rules, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'pull') AS pull_rules FROM stock_rule GROUP BY route_id ORDER BY route_id

name: picking_types_per_warehouse
note: stock.warehouse.picking_type_ids / stock.picking.type.warehouse_id (addons/stock/models/stock_picking_type.py): operation types per warehouse with the lowest sequence, as the Inventory overview groups them; types without a warehouse excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, count(*) AS picking_types, min(sequence) AS first_sequence, count(*) FILTER (WHERE code = 'incoming') AS receipts FROM stock_picking_type WHERE warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id

name: warehouses_by_id
note: StockWarehouse (addons/stock/models/stock_warehouse.py): every warehouse with its company, short code, view and stock locations and active flag (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, company_id, code, view_location_id, lot_stock_id, active FROM stock_warehouse ORDER BY id
